purpose: Parses, formats and checks record tags against the ontology's grammar and write rule.
namedChanges: the imports of the source's own files lose `.ts` (`./tag`); the imports of `./terms.ts` and `./source.ts` (`spellingOfTermDoc`, `valuesUnder`, `refsUnder`, `VocabularyUnavailableError`, `TermDoc`, `VocabularySource`) are one import of the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-vocabulary-source`, and the import of `./platform.ts` (`expectStatus`, `request`, `routeUrl`, `PlatformClient`) is an import of the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-record-sync`;

the header comment of each file is a new, shorter one, and comments that name a person, an agent, a cycle or a ticket are reworded (in `tag.ts` the TagStandard record is no longer called by its ticket number and the example tags in comments are Ann's; in `tagWriteRule.ts` "Kai's 64" reads "64" and "(N-4 r6)" reads "(a platform refusal)"; in `tagResolve.ts` the platform commit hash in the header is dropped); no code changed.
